SonicWall Patches Actively Exploited SonicOS Vulnerability Bypassing VPN MFA

SonicWall has patched seven vulnerabilities in SonicOS, including an actively exploited flaw (CVE-2026-19868) that allows attackers to bypass SAML-based MFA on SSL VPNs. The updates also fix critical unauthenticated flaws in the management interface and several pre-authentication denial-of-service vulnerabilities.

**If you run SonicWall firewalls (Gen7 or Gen8 TZ, NSa, NSsp, NSv), make sure the management interface is isolated from the internet and reachable from trusted networks only. Then update ASAP to SonicOS 7.3.4-7013 (Gen7) or 8.2.3-8015 (Gen8), especially if you use SAML for VPN logins. Attackers may already be bypassing it. Until you have patched, check your VPN logs for successful logins that skipped SAML or MFA.**
